description.value: Nero Belgian Waffle Bar is an independent, family-owned business founded by Belgian immigrants who arrived from Belgium in 2011 and began crafting authentic Brussels and Liège waffles on Robson Street in 2012. The Yaletown location is their flagship downtown spot, seating 70-plus guests and offering a full menu of sweet and savoury waffles from breakfast through late evening. Freshly baked mini Liège waffles are available daily for takeout, and a pre-order pickup option makes it easy for cyclists on the move to grab something on their schedule.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record targets the Yaletown location at 1002 Seymour St; the website's location listing for 'yaletown' confirms the same address and phone number (604) 428-9177, so contact details are verified. Takeout is explicitly confirmed by the website ('a good assortment available at each location for regular take-out'); OSM tag diet:vegetarian=yes supports vegetarian options. No website content mentions bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or any other cycling-specific amenities, so those remain null.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, well-established independent cafe in the heart of downtown Vancouver's Yaletown with indoor and outdoor seating, vegetarian options, and ready takeout—a practical and appealing refuelling stop for touring cyclists.
